reference_solution:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
all_vals = []
for line in lines:
    parts = line.split()
    if parts:
        cnt = int(parts[0])
        all_vals.extend([int(x) for x in parts[1:1+cnt]])
all_vals.sort()
print(' '.join(map(str, all_vals)))
